smoke.command: bats --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 127; test -d tests || exit 127; bats --count -r tests

permissionRequirements: fallback: bats must already be present — shell projects have no dev-scoped package manager, so nothing is installed and probe alone decides alreadyProvisioned
fallback: no tests/ directory means no test capability; the recipe reports it rather than writing a test suite

maintenance.check: compare the bats on PATH with the latest bats-core release; the recipe pins only a floor, so a newer runner needs no change
